show.description: On a desperate night outside a hospital, Hemant struggles to save his pregnant wife, Gargi, who is gasping for breath. Refused treatment and trapped by circumstances beyond their control, the couple faces an impossible situation as danger closes in around them. With time running out and no help in sight, Gargi is forced to confront a devastating truth, some choices demand a price greater than life itself.
